material.acceptance_criteria: Revives run in ascending unit id on every peer; two heroes dying on one point revive identically on all peers.
material.description: scenarios/moba/aegis.lua:42: for u,h in pairs(held) calls game.revive_at(u,x,y); a cell that cannot take the hero is retried, so revival order decides who gets the cell. pairs order is per-process random (piccolo raw.rs:64).
